description: Ellcot Spinning Mills Limited is a spinning unit of the Nagina Group, established in 1991 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, which manufactures and sells yarn. Its machinery comprises 61,968 spindles with the related process machines, spinning 100 per cent cotton, synthetic and polyester-cotton blend yarns in carded and combed form for weaving and knitting. The yarns go into apparel fabrics, sheeting, towelling, canvas and knitted products, and carry the company's own brand names Grape, Pasha and Apricot.

products.name: Grape - polyester/cotton blend yarns
products.summary: 10/1 to 60/1 polyester-cotton blend yarns, carded and combed, sold under the brand 'Grape'.

products.name: Pasha - cotton siro and slub yarns
products.summary: 10/1 to 12/1 100 per cent cotton siro, siro slub, plain and plain slub yarns, sold under the brand 'Pasha'.

products.name: Apricot - fine-count combed cotton yarns
products.summary: 30 NE to 120 NE 100 per cent combed cotton yarns spun from Pima and Giza 86 cotton, sold under the brand 'Apricot'.

products.name: Lycra core-spun yarns
products.summary: Core yarns made with Lycra, in counts 10/1 to 20/1, carded and combed, in a variety of deniers.
